headline: Sales growth continues a third quarter as margins compress
summary_short: Net sales rose 3.0% y/y to $3.96B (organic sales +1.6%) with gains across all three segments; diluted EPS grew 9.1% y/y to $0.24 even as gross margin slipped 70bp to 58.2% on inflation, tariffs and unfavorable FX.
summary_long: Net sales grew 3.0% y/y to $3.96B, driven by organic sales growth of 1.6% (value realization +0.9%, volume +0.7%) plus a 1.4% FX tailwind, with gains across all three segments. Gross margin fell 70bp y/y to 58.2% on inflation, tariffs and unfavorable FX, partly offset by supply-chain productivity savings; operating margin fell 30bp to 17.7% on higher brand support, partly offset by restructuring savings. Net income rose 8.6% to $456M and diluted EPS rose 9.1% to $0.24, helped by a lower effective tax rate (23.7% vs 28.6%). Cash was $1.1B and debt $8.5B at quarter-end. Due to the pending Kimberly-Clark acquisition, the company issued no forward guidance and held no earnings call.

drivers.explanation: Organic sales growth of 1.6% (value realization +0.9%, volume +0.7%) plus a 1.4% FX benefit; gains were broad-based across all three segments and most regions.
Inflation, tariffs and unfavorable transactional FX outweighed productivity savings from supply-chain optimization and favorable value realization.
Tracks the gross-margin decline plus higher year-over-year brand support spending, partly offset by savings from the 2026 Restructuring Initiative and Our Vue Forward.
A lower effective tax rate (23.7% vs 28.6% a year ago), reflecting a valuation-allowance release and favorable jurisdictional mix, lifted net income despite the operating-margin decline.
Tracks the net income gain; diluted weighted-average share count was roughly flat y/y (1,923M vs 1,928M), so per-share growth closely mirrors net income growth.
Not explained in the release relative to the year-ago quarter; the release itself compares cash only to the prior fiscal year-end (flat at $1.1B), not to Q2 2025.

Third consecutive quarter of net and organic sales growth across every segment and region. The pending Kimberly-Clark merger (targeted close Q4 2026) means no forward guidance was issued and no earnings call was held this quarter.
